+title: Make the two 8,192 constants tell apart in logs
+---
+## Problem
+
+`LiveModelLoader.responseTokenFloor` (the per-call output ceiling when a caller gives no `maxTokens`, `Resolution/LiveModelLoader.swift:189`) and `ProfileDefinition.defaultContext` (the context of a scripted test session) are both 8,192. A log line that says 8192 does not say which one it is. This sent an investigation after the wrong cause on 2026-09-22 (see ^46bz58k).
+
+## Do this
+
+1. Give the two values different numbers, or make each log line that prints one say which constant it is (for example `responseTokenFloor=8192`, `defaultContext=8192`).
+2. Do not change the resolved ceiling of a live session.
+
+## Acceptance
+
+- Each log line that prints one of the two values names the constant.
+- All tests pass with no change to their expected numbers, or with the expected numbers updated in the same commit.
+
+Requested by foundationmodelsacpagent-08. #compaction
\ No newline at end of file

+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m34k4ktqd7fhr7jg4fcjgvm4
+  text: |-
+    ### implement — research
+
+    Findings:
+    - `MLXFoundationModelsSessionBackend.responseTokenFloor` (`Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Resolution/LiveModelLoader.swift:189`) is 8192. It applies only when a caller gives `maxTokens: nil` and the session has no context. `RoutedSessionActor.responseTokenCeiling(requested:contextTokens:)` returns `nil` only for `contextTokens <= 0`. A live routed session always has a resolved context, so the floor never sets its ceiling.
+    - `ProfileDefinition.defaultContext` (`Sources/FoundationModelsRouter/Core/ProfileDefinition.swift:21`) is 8192. It is the context of a session with no explicit `context:`, the default of `SlotResolution.init` and `RoutedSessionActor.init`, and the fallback context of `JointFit.resolveViaLadder`.
+    - Two more constants are 8192: `RepoMetadata.defaultNativeMaxContext` and `Summarization.reasoningTokenHeadroom`. The card does not name them.
+    - No log line in `Sources/` prints the floor. No log line prints `defaultContext` by name. The lines that print a context value print a resolved or measured context: `ResolutionFailure.description` ("context N tokens"), `GenerationCallUsage.description` ("context N tokens"), and the session sidecar `context` field.
+    - The tests reference the floor by symbol only (`Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/TurnTokenCeilingTests.swift:124`, `Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/Helpers/CeilingProbeLanguageModel.swift:207`). No test hard-codes 8192 as the floor.
+    - Two comments state the floor number: `IntegrationTests/Tests/FoundationModelsRouterIntegrationTests/IntegrationTests.swift:227` and `:383`.
+
+    Plan:
+    1. Give `responseTokenFloor` a number that no other constant uses. Then a log that prints the floor cannot be read as `defaultContext`. `defaultContext` stays 8192: the footprint fixtures, the sidecar fixtures and the ladder rung 8192 depend on it.
+    2. Log one line at the point where the floor applies. The line names the constant: `responseTokenFloor=<n>`.
+    3. Update the two comments in `IntegrationTests.swift` that state the old number.
+    4. Add a test that reads the applied ceiling and that makes sure the floor is not equal to `defaultContext`.
